onboardingWelcome.subject: Welcome to Training Studio
onboardingWelcome.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

Welcome to Training Studio. Your account is now active and ready to use.

You can now sign in and begin exploring programs, events, and assessments.

Warm regards,
Team Training Studio

Your Training Studio account has been provisioned for {{tenantName}}.

Warm regards,
